scope: Historical observation on 2026-10-23, before later renderer/simulation/optimized-WASM commits. Not a measurement of the latest PR head.
protocol: One pair on Intel Iris Xe; identical diagnostic collector, manual=1 fixture with automatic simulation stopped, camera, quality, canvas 1280x720/DPR1; 60s warm-up and 300s collection per revision; no adaptive changes.

baseline.renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (0x000046A6) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

jsHeap.scope: browser-reported JS heap; excludes total process RAM and separate Worker/WASM memories

sceneReferencedResources.scope: deduplicated visible scene geometry/texture objects; buffer bytes and estimated texture payload, not GPU allocation

processRam.reason: not exposed by this browser benchmark; capture process/Worker memory with an external profiler

deviceVram.reason: actual device allocation is not exposed by WebGL renderer.info or the scene census

page.scope: browser visibility/focus only; does not prove OS foreground or occlusion

acceptance.scope: single run; three equivalent runs and both GPUs required for campaign acceptance

Rendering observation with manual=1 and simulation time at zero; not FPS of an automatically progressing match or simultaneous solver load.
Targets 69 FPS, p95 <=20 ms and 1% low >=50 FPS not met.
JS heap excludes process RAM and separate Worker/WASM memories. Scene texture/geometry census is not actual GPU allocation.
Baseline diagnostic collector was harmonized; renderer and simulation source were retained. Browser focus does not prove OS foreground/occlusion.
Later commits must not inherit these numbers as a fresh FPS measurement.
